definitions.gloss: quick wit, resourcefulness, presence of mind
definitions.explanation: The ability to think and respond quickly and cleverly in unexpected situations.

examples.japanese: {機転|きてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{機転|きてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}かせて→利く：11845_kiku⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: Using quick thinking, I overcame the crisis.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{機転|きてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}かせて→利く：11845_kiku⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}をついた→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、{大事|おおごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なら→なる：01970_naru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the quick thinking of telling a white lie in that situation, it didn't turn into a big deal.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set phrases {機転|きてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (to be quick-witted) and {機転|きてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}かせる→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (to use one's quick wit). Rarely used outside these collocations.
The verb is ⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧, not ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧. Both are read きく but have different meanings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機転|きてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧: to be resourceful, to be quick-witted
- {機転|きてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}かせる→利く：11845_kiku⟧: to use quick thinking, to think on one's feet
- {機転|きてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}かない→利く：11845_kiku⟧: to lack resourcefulness
